avoid: Excessive repetitive jumping on concrete floors
children.counts: Simple 1-2 stomp-shake counts followed by four hip sways.
children.game_version: Play 'Stamina Challenge' where dancers shake ankle rattles or shakers in a circle, freezing into statue poses whenever the master drummer stops playing.

avoid: Heavy impact stomping on hard surfaces
seniors.counts: Count in steady 4-beat phrases: step right (1), tap (2), step left (3), tap (4).
seniors.seated_version: Perform rhythmic heel and toe taps while seated upright in a sturdy armless chair to recreate rattle sounds without bearing full weight.
seniors.standing_version: Hold the back of a secure chair with one hand, executing gentle side-to-side weight transfers and soft hip sways without jumping.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Maintain a slow, steady pulse; limit hip motion to comfortable ranges and eliminate high leaps and rapid spins.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Open, expressive gestures framing the torso, balanced outward for stability during jumping and spinning.
movement_profile.footwork: Percussive downward stomps, rapid heel-toe shakes, weight shifts, and grounded pivots designed to sound leg rattles.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Circular staging transitioning into opposing gender lines and advancing couple pairings.
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Rhythmic hip rotations, lateral oscillations, and torso shivering designed to activate waist rings.
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Alternates between grounded low stances, mid-level walking steps, and explosive vertical leaps.
movement_profile.partnering: Non-contact courtship dialogue where partners face each other, mirroring steps and exchanging musical challenges.
movement_profile.posture: Upright yet grounded torso with slightly bent knees to absorb ground impacts and facilitate rapid leg shaking.

signature_moves.description: A sharp, downward foot stamp that causes dried calabash leg rattles to snap rhythmically against the lower calf.
signature_moves.name: Ebinyege rattle strike

signature_moves.description: A fluid circular or side-to-side hip movement that accentuates the beaded waist ring.
signature_moves.name: Entogoro hip oscillation

signature_moves.description: An acrobatic vertical jump executed by male dancers to showcase supreme physical stamina to partners and elders.
signature_moves.name: Courting leap

movement_profile.tempo_feel: Vigorous, driving, and athletically demanding with sudden dynamic surges.
movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Avoid stiffening the knees or landing flat-footed when wearing rattles to protect the joints during high jumps.

music_profile.musical_form: Episodic and responsive structure governed by drum breaks, flute melodies, and cues from the master of ceremonies.
music_profile.sound_description: A dense, driving acoustic texture defined by the sharp, percussive crack of dried gourd leg rattles locked to low- and mid-toned traditional drums. Above the percussive base, wooden xylophone bars and aerophone flutes weave bright counter-melodies, punctuated by dynamic vocal calls, praises, and crowd cheers from the omukama.
music_profile.vocal_style: Chanted praise singing, call-and-response vocalizations, and spoken comedic banter led by the master of ceremonies.

basic_steps: Stomp the right foot into the floor to sound the leg rattle (ebinyege) on the downbeat.
Transfer weight smoothly to the left foot while engaging a quick rebound strike.
Isolate and circle the hips rhythmically so the waist ring (entogoro) swings laterally.
Execute an explosive vertical hop, landing simultaneously on both feet to produce a unified rattle crash.
Perform a controlled spin on the ball of the foot while sustaining continuous hip rotation.
teaching.formation: Concentric or open circles, parallel facing lines of men and women, and individual courtship pairings.
teaching.level_notes: Beginners must master ankle stability and rattle timing before attempting continuous spins or vertical leaps.
teaching.rhythm: Polyrhythmic drumming patterns alternating between steady driving tempos and accelerating cadence cues.
